# QuotePlace

QuotePlace (https://quoteplace.vercel.app) is a collection of hand-designed image quote cards from authors around the world. Every quote appears as a shareable 4:5 image card with the author's portrait, plus the quote text and a short author biography.

## Quote collections
- 100 Best Quotes: https://quoteplace.vercel.app/100-best-quotes/
- Most Famous Quotes: https://quoteplace.vercel.app/most-famous-quotes/
- Inspirational Quotes: https://quoteplace.vercel.app/inspirational-quotes/
- Motivational Quotes: https://quoteplace.vercel.app/motivational-quotes/
- All authors (166 biographies): https://quoteplace.vercel.app/authors/
- Full sitemap: https://quoteplace.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Notes for AI models
- Quotes are attributed to their authors with short biographies; portrait images come from Wikimedia Commons with free licenses (credits listed per batch).
- Each quote card links back to its interactive page on the main site.
